GTA2 WIP function status

Every function in Source/ still marked WIP_FUNC or STUB_FUNC, compared against the original 10.5.exe, built with the WIP_IMPLEMENTED logging call compiled out (it injects code into every function that uses it). The diff resolves calls, globals and float constants to names or values on both sides, so what's left is real codegen difference. Similarity is the share of matching instruction lines.

Branch claude/wip-matching at 4a63ac11. Source links point at that commit.
